assumption: When run-scoped permission requests with the same full interaction scope coalesce, only the first caller receives the provider prompt delivery callback; all callers share the settlement decision.
guidance: Owner-confirmed callback policy in the SCHED-4B-1 final amendment.

assumption: A process crash between shared durable permission-row creation and provider delivery can leave the setup fingerprint with an instruction card but no approval button until its blocker set changes; the owner retains the manual request_access or manage-access path.
guidance: Owner-confirmed containment: a canonical durable ownership or lease reissue design affects the shared permission path, including request_access, and is deferred.

assumption: No durable scheduler run-to-progress-card identity exists; stale-lease cleanup after process death sends the terminal timeout receipt but cannot safely replace the old running card in SCHED-4B-2.
guidance: Binding S2-7 explicitly selects bounded outcome B when no durable run-to-card identity exists; current evidence shows only process-local run ownership plus route-keyed channel state.
